name: Tabletop RPG Room
subtitle: The Cabinet of a Thousand Worlds (Gabinete de los Mil Mundos)
description: A universal tabletop role-playing room: a steampunk cabinet of wonders to play any game, with its system, an invented one or none. Round walnut table for eight, the Game Master's staff, server-rolled dice, a map on the table, and a 40-minute guided practice (The Awakened Atlas).
previous_published_version: 1.0.0 (Tholos, tag tabletop-rpg-room-v1.0.0, not yet in main)
creator: Numen Games
owner_note: Person or organisation; pending the ATH21 consultation (DECISIONES-MUNDOS 2026-11-07, round 2 item 2).

status.en: pending: in-world text is still Spanish only (usted)
status.es: complete (translation of the English default once it exists)
